senses.gloss: m. (fr. זִיוָה, fem. form of זִיו, formed like גֵּיוְתָן) bright, distinguished, noble. constr. זֵיוְתָנֵי.
units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 11a:9">R. Hash. 11ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>זִו</he>, <cite ref="I Kings 6:1">I Kings VI, 1</cite>) <he>שבו נבראו ז׳ עולם</he> for in that month were created the nobles of the world (the patriarchs).
